name: telegram
description: Send and receive Telegram messages via @Oadsonbot. Use when the user asks OADSON to send something to Telegram, check Telegram messages, or manage the bot webhook.

action.description: send_message: send text to Telegram. send_file: send a file/document. send_photo: send an image. get_updates: read recent messages. get_chat_id: get the owner's chat ID. set_webhook/delete_webhook: manage bot webhook.

file_url.description: File URL for send_file or send_photo.

caption.description: Optional caption for send_photo or send_file.
